title: Dash & Robyn Engagement
summary: A golden-hour engagement session for Dash and Robyn, from the ring reveal to the quiet moments after.
blurb: Dash and Robyn are a couple I was thrilled to photograph on the evening of their engagement. We shot into the last of the golden hour, working quickly around the roses and fairy lights to catch the ring, the bouquet, and the way the two of them kept falling back into each other between frames. It was a privilege to be trusted with a moment this personal, and to hand them back images that hold the feeling of the day.
